name: Cluster
description: Horizontal group that wraps, with a gap and vertically centered items: button groups, badge lists, tags.

whenToUse: Button groups, badge lists, tags and metadata rows that should wrap on narrow screens.
whenNotToUse: Two columns of page content: use `l-sidebar` or `l-grid`.
Items that must stay equal width: use `l-switcher`.
use: Group inline items such as buttons and badges.
avoid: Using l-cluster for two-column page layouts; use l-sidebar or l-grid.

do.text: Let items wrap; the gap holds on every row.
